using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Moq;
using OpenRA.Mods.Common.Widgets.Logic;
using OpenRA.Primitives;
using Xunit;

namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_SetsFetchingStatus()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert
			Assert.Equal(ServerListLogic.SearchStatus.Fetching, logic.GetPrivateField<SearchStatus>("searchStatus"));
		}

		[Fact]
		public async Task RefreshServerList_SkipsWhenActiveQuery()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin);
			logic.SetPrivateField("activeQuery", true);

			// Act
			logic.RefreshServerList();

			// Assert - status shouldn't change from default
			Assert.NotEqual(ServerListLogic.SearchStatus.Fetching, logic.GetPrivateField<ServerListLogic.SearchStatus>("searchStatus"));
		}

		[Fact]
		public void ProgressLabelText_ReturnsEmpty_ForFetching()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin);
			logic.SetPrivateField("searchStatus", ServerListLogic.SearchStatus.Fetching);

			// Act
			var result = logic.ProgressLabelText();

			// Assert
			Assert.Empty(result);
		}

		[Fact]
		public void ProgressLabelText_ReturnsFailedMessage_ForFailed()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = Mock.Of<ModData>();
			var onJoin = new Action<GameServer>(_ => { });
			var widget = Mock.Of<OpenRA.Widgets.Widget>();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(widget, modData, onJoin);
			logic.SetPrivateField("searchStatus", ServerListLogic.SearchStatus.Failed);

			// Act
			var result = logic.ProgressLabelText();

			// Assert
			Assert.NotEmpty(result);
		}
	}

	public static class PrivateFieldExtensions
	{
		public static T GetPrivateField<T>(this object obj, string fieldName)
		{
			var field = obj.GetType().GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			return (T)field?.GetValue(obj);
		}

		public static void SetPrivateField(this object obj, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			var field = obj.GetType().GetField(fieldName, System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
			field?.SetValue(obj, value);
		}
	}
}
